column1: # ZAP API scan policy for the staging API (ADR 0021, Phase 3 build item 3b).
# One rule per line: <plugin id> <tab> IGNORE|WARN|FAIL <tab> note. Rules not listed stay at WARN, which the
# Deploy workflow reports but does not fail on (-I); FAIL blocks promotion. Change a verdict only with a reason
# here and a note in the pull request: this file is a gate (CLAUDE.md rule 2).
# Injection and code execution: the API takes book text, which is untrusted input (CLAUDE.md rule 6).

column3: Cross-site scripting (persistent): reported, not failed. The API echoes book text back in JSON only, with nosniff and a CSP that forbids rendering, so the stored text is a weakness for a renderer, not for this API; the web app escapes it (React). A title with a script tag is legitimate book text and must round-trip unchanged.

column3: Server header leaks version information (Kestrel's header is off)

column1: # Headers the API sets on every answer (SecurityHeaders.cs); missing ones mean a regression.
